tool-map.title: One configuration file, every script
tool-map.alt: Diagram: app_config.yml is read by config_loader.sh and by the Python scripts generate_matrix.py and get_app_info.py; build_app.sh, flash_app.sh, manage_idf.sh and idf_flash_monitor.sh use them; build_app.sh runs idf.py into a build folder under builds/; hf-espidf-ci-tools calls generate_matrix.py and build_app.sh.
tool-map.description: From top to bottom. app_config.yml in the ESP-IDF project lists the apps, ESP-IDF versions, build types and target. Two readers parse it: config_loader.sh, which the shell scripts source, and the Python scripts generate_matrix.py and get_app_info.py. The commands that source config_loader.sh (read from the scripts) sit on top of them. build_app.sh drives idf.py and writes one build folder per app, build type, target and ESP-IDF version under builds/. In CI, hf-espidf-ci-tools runs generate_matrix.py and build_app.sh.
